'''Los Dor''' was a [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith]] [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] during the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]]. He served under [[Saes Rrogon]] aboard the [[Sith dreadnaught]] [[Harbinger (Sith dreadnaught)|''Harbinger'']], and served as a spy for [[Naga Sadow/Legends|Naga Sadow]], keeping tabs on Rrogon's actions and worthiness to be a [[Sith/Legends|Sith]]. He perished when [[Drev Hassin]] crashed his [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Infiltrator (starfighter)|Infiltrator]] into the [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]] of ''Harbinger''.
